Author: Sanaka
Name: Gearbook
Punchline: Every gearset, sorted, filtered, one click to switch.
Description:
The game lists your gearsets by name and nothing else. Gearbook adds what that list is missing: a search, filters by role and category, favourites, your own tags and notes, and a compact bar of job icons you can leave on screen and click to switch. It is built for the case the game handles worst, several sets for the same job, so a dark knight for one fight, another for a different one, and a third for a glamour are three separate entries rather than one guess.

What it does not do: nothing happens on its own. Gearbook never switches a gearset, never sends anything to the game, and never acts in any way unless you click or type something. There is no automation, no queueing, no acting on your behalf while you are away. It reads what the game already shows you and puts it in a better order.

It needs no account, no server and no internet connection. Nothing leaves your machine.
